method.stopDefinition: Original reference stays fixed. Alter only stop using fraction of original reference risk, closed-candle ATR14 or final confirmation high/low plus ATR buffer. ATR14 is simple mean of contiguous true ranges. Missing ATR rejects that setup. Fixed-original-distance target stays at original 1.25R; new-risk targets are multiples of the revised reference-to-stop distance. Common target across both entries. Pending orders retire at experimental target/SL or 30min.
method.qualification: Same archived qualified setups, both directions, original confirmation filters. Changes to stop deliberately define a different research strategy. No BE, early close or compounding.
method.execution: Existing exhaustive OHLC engine, historical M15 and Nov18-20 M1. Same per-leg 300-pip validity cap inherited. Unknown/open outcomes excluded, and uncertainty exclusions can vary with stop. Dollar risk covers both entries. No margin/daily/concurrent-risk modeling; drawdown excludes floating losses.
method.costs: Illustrative .20/.50 gold-price-unit total round-trip cost plus $7/lot. Assumed contract100oz, min/step.01, rounded down. If split cannot fit, second-only with up to full $50 budget. Not actual broker quotes/fills; entry/stop prices not tick rounded. Risk assertions <=$50, cash/monthly reconciliation, baseline parity.
method.selection: Train score net - half drawdown, min40 resolved, min12 in each training month, min45% resolved wins. Train AugSep for Oct and AugOct for historical Nov. Cost-aware selection scored separately. Full-period winners explicitly hindsight. Entire history reused from earlier research. No claim of independent validation.
